button.label: Run script
button.screentip: Run a script of the library
button.supertip: Lists the .vas files of the library folder and runs the one you pick. A script whose header asks for the selection gets the selected range as $1.

button.label: Library folder
button.supertip: The folder of the scripts that ASF_CALL and Run script use, and the only folder imports read.

button.label: Why this error?
button.screentip: Why ASF_RUN, ASF_CALL or a Python function gave an error
button.supertip: Calculates the active cell again and shows the message of its ASF_RUN or ASF_CALL, or the Python error and traceback of its PY_CALL or Python function when the Python add-in is loaded.

button.label: Reset engine
button.screentip: Reset the engine of the worksheet functions
button.supertip: Drops the compiled scripts and reads the settings again on the next formula.

button.label: Python folder
button.supertip: The folder of the Python modules whose functions the Python add-in (asfpy64.xll or asfpy32.xll) registers and PY_CALL calls.

button.label: Reload Python
button.supertip: The Python add-in imports the modules of its folder again and registers their functions, then the workbooks are calculated in full. Python and its packages stay loaded.

button.label: Python packages
button.supertip: Opens a console window with pip for the Python of the Python add-in, such as install numpy. Excel uses new packages after a restart.
